title: Von's Mods
description: My Mods For A Perfect Fabric Experience And PVP
body:
# Von's Mods
Von's Mods is a comprehensive Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric modpack designed to provide a high-performance, quality-of-life-focused vanilla plus experience. By carefully selecting forty-one distinct modifications, this pack aims to modernize the technical foundation of the game while preserving its original charm.

**Performance and Optimization**
The pack is built around several key pillars of improvement. For performance and optimization, the inclusion of industry-standard mods like Sodium significantly enhances frame rates and rendering efficiency. Other technical fixes, such as Packet Fixer, ensure that network and internal data handling remain stable during gameplay.

**Interface and Utility**
Navigation is made seamless through the Mod Menu, which provides an organized interface to view and configure all installed modifications. For improved inventory management and crafting support, Roughly Enough Items is included as a core utility. The pack also features essential configuration libraries like Cloth Config and YetAnotherConfigLib, which allow for deep customization of various mod settings.

**Exploration and Stability**
Exploration is further enhanced with navigational aids like Xaero's World Map and visual utilities like Zoomify for focusing on distant details. Behind-the-scenes improvements, such as Debugify, fix numerous vanilla bugs, while the Fabric API serves as the necessary foundation for mod compatibility and stability. Overall, Von's Mods offers a robust and stable environment that runs smoothly across various hardware configurations, making it a perfect starting point for any modern survival adventure.
